translations.name: NJ State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP)
translations.description: The NJ State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) helps people with Medicare. There is no income test, and you must be a New Jersey Medicare beneficiary. Call 1-800-792-8820, Monday to Friday 8:30am-4:30pm.
translations.website_description: Learn about help with medical bills and prescriptions.
